_about: Per-file test-seconds summed from a gate log's parallel reporter lines at 5f7e345d6210d2347d97422bbad8c852bbf3bbfb (2026-11-08); ordering estimates, NOT isolated wall timings. Re-derived by scripts/update-test-weights.mjs (chrome-agent-platform-jw8a6) from the quietest COMPLETE post-wasm-split gate log available on this VM (impl-a lane fast gate for tree 451a50399, PASS, 2026-11-06, 772 measured suites; steal mostly 0.8-9.2%, spikes to 20%, serial scale x1.56 - vs the weekly review's 737385e9 FULL log measured under ~71% avg steal, whose wall attribution inflated callexport-admission to '391s' that this quiet log measures at 20.3s). Supersedes the 2026-10-16 table (80 entries, tree 55876826) and ifu81's 2026-10-24 hand-patched wasm-sync sibling weights (which carried the same steal inflation: 145/145/92/140/124 hand-set vs 5/6/5/8/5 measured quiet). Used ONLY to order selected files; never decides which files run (see _provenance, docs/TEST-COUPLING-INVENTORY.md entry 23). tests/parallel-schedule.test.ts rejects non-parallel, deferred, missing, or read-only-dist names.

_provenance.measured_host: the fleet VM that produced the source gate log (8 vCPU)
_provenance.measured_method: summed per-test durations from one FULL gate log's `deno test --parallel` reporter lines (scripts/lib/parallel-durations.mjs; step lines excluded so parent totals are not double-counted). Test-seconds under parallel load, not isolated wall seconds: the right RELATIVE input for longest-first ordering, not a per-file time budget.
_provenance.rederivation: node scripts/update-test-weights.mjs <full-gate-log> --tree <sha-of-logged-tree> — the log's own manifest suite_durations carries the same numbers; either source re-derives this table.
_provenance.refreshed_scope: durations recalibrated from the 5f7e345d log (chrome-agent-platform-jw8a6): 80 entries -> 104; every eligible >=3s file the log measured now carries a weight, so re-running scripts/update-test-weights.mjs against THIS log is a no-op; files the log never measured (heavy tier, read-only-dist batch, unselected) keep their given order
_provenance.guarantee: ordering only: the table may reorder the parallel set but can never add, drop or deselect a file (tests/parallel-schedule.test.ts pins the permutation against the live selection)
_provenance.off_switch: CAP_PARALLEL_SCHEDULE=0 disables this ordering entirely (scripts/run-tests.mjs); documented in docs/CHROME-TEST-CONTRACT.md
_provenance.measured_log: ~/.fleet/checks/5f7e345d6210d2347d97422bbad8c852bbf3bbfb.fast.log (gate for tree 451a50399, PASS, 2026-11-06; CHANGE-SELECTED fast-gate parallel phase, 772 measured suites - not the full gate; the review's FULL logs 29301c9e/737385e9 live on the hub VM and the latter ran under ~71% avg steal)
_provenance.measured_steal: in-log steal samples mostly 0.8-9.2% with spikes to 20%; serial timeout scaled x1.56 (base 180s x load 1.56 per CPU). Relative ordering trusted; absolute seconds are not comparable to stolen runs.
